messages:
owen: Quick heads-up for the 00:30-02:30 UTC window. Small coordinated rollout across runtime/api/router/console. Planned pin order: runtime -> api -> router -> console. Versions: runtime@2.5.0 api@1.14.0 router@3.9.5 console@4.2.0. Zoe, can you confirm warmup + migration flags?

deploybot: Deploybot: preflight OK. Will run sequenced pins with 7s spacing. Will post event ids and step updates.

zoe: Ack. Warmup plan: prime KV prefixes session/*, ctx/* and hit /ops/warmup on each shard. Canary: 5% traffic for 6m to runtime-canary. Console has a data-compat toggle FF-console-2026 that can be turned off instantly. DB migration is non-blocking but watch replica lag.

pratik: Rollback thresholds: sustained error rate >0.6% for 3m OR p99 latency >900ms. If triggered, emergency flow: 1) mute alerts 2) unpin console/router first to limit user impact 3) if still bad, unpin api then runtime. Oncall Sam has unpin perms.

oncall_sam: I have perms. Runbook: https://internal/runbooks/quick-unpin. Quick panic unpin via deploybot:

```
# trigger deploybot unpin action
curl -X POST "https://deploybot.internal/actions" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"action":"unpin","services":["console","router"] ,"reason":"panic-unpin"}'
```

owen: thanks. I'll hold the canary watch for first 12 minutes and post snapshots. Also adding rollback steps to release notes.

deploybot: runtime pinned (evt: evt_177a). Now warming runtime canary.

zoe: warmup started 00:24. /ops/warmup returned 200 across 5 shards. KV priming logs show no evictions. Canary traffic shifted at 00:30.

pratik: Canary +4m: error rate 0.03%, p99 +15ms. Good so far. Keep watch.

deploybot: api pinned -> router pending -> console queued.

zoe: note: console feature toggles ready if we need to disable UI path quickly. FF-console-2026 available.

pratik: Reminder: if we see a short spike but metrics recover within 2m and no customer reports, prefer wait for canary to stabilize. Immediate unpin only if thresholds crossed.

oncall_sam: If I run panic-unpin I'll: 1) mute the deploy-noise alerts 2) call incident and tag #incidents 3) post timeline here.

deploybot: router pinned -> console pending (evt: evt_177b). Smoke tests starting.

owen: smoke ok at 00:46. No errors in logs, DB lag within thresholds. Closing watch in 10m unless flagged. Adding short note in release_notes.md with the unpin snippets.

zoe: final: all good from runtime side. leaving a note about KV TTL tuning (in case we see tiny latency blips later).

pratik: thanks team. Closing thread: rollout completed, pins applied, smoke green. I'll update rollback playbook with the console fast-toggle command. :white_check_mark:
